snippet.title: Demon Queen Melissa - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Melissa becomes the new demon queen after her father is defeated. She decides against her father's way of life and wishes to coexist alongside humans. But when the hero Lufia visits and activates a sacred seal, Melissa loses all of her magic. How will Melissa regain her power?
